_note: B59 outdoor flea market: time, origin & age adjectives. English sound-alike hooks acted on each item.

fr_different_adj.hook: One jug in the row is red and all the others are white – it's the DIFFERENT one (dee-fay-RAHN).

fr_prochain_adj.hook: One boot already has a PRO SHINE – the dusty boot beside it is NEXT in line (pro-SHAN).

fr_commun_adj.hook: 'COME ON!' – two teddies share one seesaw: it belongs to them in COMMON (ko-MAN).

fr_inconnu_adj.hook: A mystery parcel sits IN a CANOE – nobody knows who sent it: UNKNOWN (an-ko-NU).

fr_suivant_adj.hook: The SWEET VAN rolls in right after the boots – the FOLLOWING thing on the stall (swee-VAHN).

fr_futur_adj.hook: Inside the crystal ball a tiny rocket blasts off into the FUTURE (fu-TUR).

fr_age_adj.hook: The rocking horse is cracked and faded – it has AGED a lot: old (a-ZHAY).

fr_quotidien_adj.hook: The coat and hat on the peg are worn EVERY DAY – QUOTIDIAN, daily (ko-tee-DYAN).

fr_actuel_adj.hook: The puppets ACT WELL in the show that's on RIGHT NOW (ak-TU-el).

fr_original_adj.hook: This brass gramophone is the very first ORIGINAL – all the others are copies.

fr_ordinaire_adj.hook: Just a plain brown teapot – nothing special, perfectly ORDINARY (or-dee-NAIR).

fr_recent_adj.hook: A RAY shines on the stool that was just SAWN – RAY-SAWN, very RECENT (ray-SAHN).

fr_precedent_adj.hook: The book holds flowers PRESSED last year – from the PRECEDING, previous season (pray-say-DAHN).

fr_contemporain_adj.hook: The swirly silver sculpture is brand-new modern art – CONTEMPORARY (kon-tahn-po-RAN).

fr_inevitable_adj.hook: Push the first domino and the rest must fall – it's INEVITABLE (ee-nay-vee-TABL).

fr_perpetuel_adj.hook: The Newton's cradle clicks back and forth for ever – PERPETUAL motion (pair-pay-TU-el).

fr_successif_adj.hook: Each nesting doll comes out of the one before – SUCCESSIVE dolls, one after another (suk-say-SEEF).

fr_primitif_adj.hook: The round stone wheel is the very first, PRIMITIVE kind (pree-mee-TEEF).

fr_veuf_adj.hook: The lone swan has lost its mate and sighs 'VUFF…' – widowed (veuf).

fr_orphelin_adj.hook: The odd sock lost its partner, toppled OR FELL IN the basket – an ORPHAN sock (or-fuh-LAN).

fr_mouvant_adj.hook: The ant has to MOVE, ANT! – the sand in its jar keeps shifting: MOVE-ANT, moving (moo-VAHN).

fr_obscur_adj.hook: The lantern is OBSCURED – dark and dim inside (op-SKUR).

fr_banal_adj.hook: Just a BANANA – nothing could be more BANAL and ordinary (ba-NAL).

fr_romain_adj.hook: A ROW-MAN pulls the oars of the little ROMAN galley (ro-MAN).

fr_grec_adj.hook: The painted vase with its key-pattern border is GREEK (grek).

fr_antique_adj.hook: The tarnished hand mirror is an ANTIQUE – ancient (ahn-TEEK).

fr_pascal_adj.hook: PASS the painted egg to CAL – it's an Easter egg: PASS-CAL (pas-KAL).

fr_relatif_adj.hook: The small teddy looks tiny only next to the big one – size is RELATIVE (ruh-la-TEEF).

fr_egyptien_adj.hook: A cat sits proudly in front of a pyramid – EGYPTIAN (ay-zheep-SYAN).

fr_automobile_adj.hook: The toy car drives itself – AUTO-MOBILE, self-moving (o-to-mo-BEEL).

fr_algerien_adj.hook: Green ALGAE grows in the tiled pot – ALGAE-RIAN, Algerian (al-zhay-RYAN).

fr_mediterraneen_adj.hook: A tiny blue MEDITERRANEAN sea sloshes inside the bottle (may-dee-tay-ra-nay-AN).

fr_marocain_adj.hook: 'MA ROCKS!' – the pointed slipper is full of pebbles: Moroccan (ma-ro-KAN).

fr_initial_adj.hook: These tiny shoes were the baby's very first, INITIAL pair (ee-nee-SYAL).

fr_conventionnel_adj.hook: Three teddies hold a CONVENTION – all dressed the same, very CONVENTIONAL (kon-vahn-syo-NEL).

fr_previsible_adj.hook: The barometer points to rain and the cloud is already dripping – totally PREDICTABLE (pray-vee-ZEEBL).

fr_primordial_adj.hook: A bowl of green PRIMORDIAL soup – where everything began; essential (pree-mor-DYAL).

fr_systematique_adj.hook: The jars are sorted by colour in a SYSTEM – SYSTEMATIC (sees-tay-ma-TEEK).

fr_existant_adj.hook: The wind-up ant proves it's real: 'I EXIST, ANT!' – EXIST-ANT, existing (eg-zee-STAHN).

fr_prealable_adj.hook: The jar gets a PRE-LABEL before anything goes in – done beforehand, prior (pray-a-LABL).

fr_recherche_adj.hook: The magnifying glass does RE-SEARCH on the book – it's SEARCHED for, sought-after (ruh-shair-SHAY).

fr_preliminaire_adj.hook: The easel holds a PRELIMINARY sketch, done before the real painting (pray-lee-mee-NAIR).

fr_preparatoire_adj.hook: The whisk and bowl PREPARE the batter – PREPARATORY work (pray-pa-ra-TWAR).

fr_consecutif_adj.hook: Three ducks follow one another in a row – CONSECUTIVE (kon-say-ku-TEEF).

fr_architectural_adj.hook: The little domed temple model is an ARCHITECTURAL piece (ar-shee-tek-tu-RAL).

fr_initiatique_adj.hook: The golden key lets you INITIATE the new member – an initiation key (ee-nee-sya-TEEK).

fr_tardif_adj.hook: The TARDY snail rides the clock and still arrives late (tar-DEEF).

fr_immuable_adj.hook: 'I'M MOO-ABLE?' – no: the cow is stuck fast on its block, UNCHANGEABLE (ee-mu-ABL).

fr_optimiste_adj.hook: The sunflower always turns to the bright side – OPTIMISTIC (op-tee-MEEST).

fr_fervent_adj.hook: The FUR muff sits over a hot VENT, glowing with warm passion – FUR-VENT, fervent (fair-VAHN).

fr_nostalgique_adj.hook: The music box plays an old tune that makes everyone NOSTALGIC (nos-tal-ZHEEK).

fr_temporel_adj.hook: The hourglass measures TIME, grain by grain – TEMPORAL (tahn-po-REL).

fr_ponctuel_adj.hook: The hole PUNCH clicks exactly on the hour beside the watch – PUNCTUAL (ponk-TU-el).

fr_revelateur_adj.hook: The curtain is pulled back to REVEAL a shining star – REVEALING (ray-vay-la-TUR).

fr_centenaire_adj.hook: The cake has candles for a hundred years – CENT, a CENTENARY (sahn-tuh-NAIR).

fr_rafraichissant_adj.hook: The fan wafts a cool breeze – REFRESHING (ra-fray-shee-SAHN).

fr_vieillissant_adj.hook: The candle grows shorter and droopier as it burns – AGEING (vyay-yee-SAHN).

fr_recurrent_adj.hook: The little boat goes round and round on the CURRENT in its bowl – RECURRENT (ray-ku-RAHN).

fr_obsolete_adj.hook: The rotary phone is OBSOLETE – nobody dials like that any more (ob-so-LET).

fr_futuriste_adj.hook: The shiny robot looks like it came from the future – FUTURISTIC (fu-tu-REEST).

fr_decouvert_adj.hook: The chest lid is lifted to UNCOVER the gold – DIS-COVERED, uncovered (day-koo-VAIR).

fr_legendaire_adj.hook: A green dragon straight out of a LEGEND – LEGENDARY (lay-zhahn-DAIR).

fr_venerable_adj.hook: The ancient bonsai is so old you bow to it – VENERABLE (vay-nay-RABL).

fr_rustique_adj.hook: The wooden butter churn is a RUSTIC country tool (rus-TEEK).

fr_baroque_adj.hook: A gold BAR ROCKS on top of the curly gilded mirror – BAR-ROCK, baroque (ba-ROK).

fr_mythique_adj.hook: A unicorn – the MYTHICAL creature of old stories (mee-TEEK).

fr_indigene_adj.hook: Wild native flowers grow IN a DENIM JEAN pouch – IN-DEE-JEAN, indigenous (an-dee-ZHEN).

fr_prehistorique_adj.hook: A toy dinosaur from PREHISTORIC times (pray-ees-to-REEK).

fr_archeologique_adj.hook: Dug-up pottery shards laid out in a tray, ready for the ARCHAEOLOGIST – ARCHAEOLOGICAL finds (ar-kay-o-lo-ZHEEK).

fr_archaique_adj.hook: The old wooden ARK is ARK-AIC – very, very old-fashioned (ar-ka-EEK).

fr_feodal_adj.hook: The toy castle belongs to a FEUDAL lord (fay-o-DAL).

fr_artisanal_adj.hook: The jug was shaped by hand by an ARTISAN – ARTISANAL, handmade (ar-tee-za-NAL).

fr_fossile_adj.hook: The spiral ammonite has turned to stone – a FOSSIL (fo-SEEL).

fr_originel_adj.hook: The very first egg in the nest – the ORIGINAL one, where it all began (o-ree-zhee-NEL).

fr_venitien_adj.hook: A little merchant ship sails home to VENICE across its painted canal – VENETIAN (vay-nee-SYAN).

fr_crucial_adj.hook: Pull out the keystone and the whole arch falls – it's CRUCIAL (kru-SYAL).

fr_germanique_adj.hook: A carved cuckoo clock from the Black Forest – GERMANIC (zhair-ma-NEEK).

fr_asiatique_adj.hook: A red paper lantern glows – ASIATIC, Asian (a-zya-TEEK).

fr_anglo_saxon_adj.hook: The SAX is ON a slant – ANGLE-SAX-ON, Anglo-Saxon (ahn-glo-sak-SON).

fr_tunisien_adj.hook: The blue-and-white birdcage plays a TUNE – TUNE-ISIAN, Tunisian (tu-nee-ZYAN).

fr_celte_adj.hook: The knot brooch fastens a CELT's cloak – CELT (selt).

fr_celtique_adj.hook: A little harp plays a CELTIC tune (sel-TEEK).

fr_equatorial_adj.hook: The globe wears a belt round its EQUATOR – EQUATORIAL (ay-kwa-to-RYAL).

fr_alpin_adj.hook: AL has PINned his little flag on the snowy peak – AL-PIN, alpine (al-PAN).

fr_eolien_adj.hook: The pinwheel windmill spins in the wind – Aeolus the wind god's: AEOLIAN, wind-powered (ay-o-LYAN).

fr_trentenaire_adj.hook: The steam TRAIN puffs TEN AIR clouds, three times – THIRTY years old (trahn-tuh-NAIR).

fr_gallo_romain_adj.hook: A GALLIC rooster in a ROMAN mosaic – GALLO-ROMAN (ga-lo-ro-MAN).
